_meta.why: Single source of truth for Maya's gestures. Director buttons, the brain's allowed [TAGS], and the page's auto-triggers are ALL generated from this file. Adding a future bake must cost ONE line here and zero code (03-GESTURE-ENGINE design rule).
_meta.resolution: 1080x1920 (Maya family). RESOLUTION LAW: never mix nova_* and maya_* in one stream session.
_meta.verified: All six avatars baked COMPLETE on volume 1ditrne6cb 2026-08-04, latents.pt 2017677 bytes each, 121 frames. maya_idle + maya_goodbye additionally load-tested live via /set_avatar.

_runtime.queue_rule: One gesture at a time. Fire -> /set_avatar -> timer secs -> back to idle. A new request during playback queues at depth 1, newest wins, older queued dropped.
_runtime.fire_on_why: Avatar swap is near-instant but the voice pipeline is 1-3s (measured on Nova: median 1.95s, range 1.47-3.84s). Firing at text-generation puts the wave seconds before the word. The brain emits `gesture` when TTS AUDIO STARTS so the wave lands with the greeting, not before it. This is the freeze-game sync lesson applied on day one.
_runtime.on_set_avatar_failure: stay idle, log once, never retry-loop mid-stream
